tran 4e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize

meas tran Iin_avg avg i(vin) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Iin_avg
meas tran Iout_avg avg i(vr_load_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Iout_avg
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_IIN.csv i(vin)
let VIN = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_VIN.csv v(n0)
let VOUT_csv_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)

plot i(vin) title 'tr_reg_IIN'
plot v(n0) title 'tr_reg_VIN'
plot VOUT_csv_diff title 'tr_reg_VOUT'

plot i(VSW_SENSE) title 'I_SW'
plot v_T1_auto title 'V_T1'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_PRI) title 'I_T1_pri'

let Vout_min_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
meas tran Vout_min min Vout_min_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_min
let VOUT_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
let VOUT_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
meas tran rise_time_10_90 TRIG VOUT_diff VAL=1.2000000000000002 RISE=1 TARG VOUT_diff VAL=10.8 RISE=1

let VOUT_diff = v(n5) - v(n6)
meas tran settle_to_upper TRIG AT=1e-06 TARG VOUT_diff VAL=12.059999999999999 CROSS=LAST
